{"code": "# Re-run the analysis with explicit checks and printed evidence

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check status values
print("Unique status values:", df['status'].unique())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify no NaNs after conversion
if df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum() > 0:
    print("Warning: There are NaN values after cleaning.")
else:
    print("No NaN values found after cleaning.")

# Filter completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Print number of completed orders
print("Number of completed orders:", len(df_completed))

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print mean
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue_completed)

# Print summary statistics of cleaned revenue for completed orders
print("Summary of cleaned revenue for completed orders:")
print(df_completed['revenue_clean'].describe())"}
